scope: Local implementation of the F11-01 run-store writer and readers, slice RS-2 (RD-MP-21): src/postgres/mp-run-store.js with its PostgreSQL tests. No service, route or worker calls it; nothing is installed on any environment.
method: A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote RS-2 from the run-store design and the root decisions; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed it and found a paging hole for runs with the same time and an isolation check that ran too late; root ruled; the coder fixed them; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that names the run-store modules (found with git grep): 4 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (89 tests, 0 fail, 0 skipped), the static isolation test, the grant text test and the full unit suite. The unit suite showed that the run-contract import guard refused the new run-store module, which imports the contract validator by design; root allowed exactly that module in the guard (the static isolation test proves no runtime root reaches it), confirmed that the guard still fails with an empty allowlist, and reran the full unit suite alone: 2321 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo. Root edited the import guard and verified that edit itself, with no independent check of the guard edit: an empty allowlist fails the guard, and the full unit suite, run by root alone, passed 2321 tests with 0 fail. Apart from that root edit, nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: test/postgres/mp-run-store-writer.test.mjs 30 of 30 and test/postgres/mp-run-store.test.mjs 31 of 31 pass with 0 skipped.

mutations.round2: 7 of 7 killed (keyset tie, next cursor, isolation check, order mapping, a reader event check, a deployment lock, the U+0000 refusal).

limits: Only the fixture role on an isolated cluster can use the module; the runtime role gets 42501.
The admission service (RS-5) must retry the whole transaction, roll back on a database refusal and pass only builder output; the module does not enforce these.
No service, route or worker calls it.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted RS-2 as local engineering evidence for F11-01. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
